candidates.source_name: MNB Intézménykereső (Search of market participants / institution finder)

negative_findings.description: No MNB register or publication was found that names the technology suppliers (POS terminal vendors, switch/processing software, HSM, terminal management) used by Hungarian PSPs. Registers enumerate legal entities and licence scopes, not their IT supply chain.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches on AFR technology supplier terms returned MNB programme pages and press coverage, but no supplier-level register field.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The A6 vendor-mapping objective cannot be satisfied from MNB registers alone; supplier identity must be inferred from procurement portals (EKR/TED), outsourcing notifications, or vendor press releases.

negative_findings.description: MNB Payment Systems Reports and payment statistics publish aggregate acquirer-side metrics (acceptance points, POS terminals, transaction values) but I did not find a published table attributing market share to named acquirers.
negative_findings.result_summary: Report excerpts describe market-level growth (e.g. online acceptance points +20.7%, physical -2%) without per-acquirer breakdown.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Competitor ranking on the acquiring side will need the Aranykönyv institution-level data or commercial sources rather than the payment statistics set.

negative_findings.description: I did not establish whether intezmenykereso.mnb.hu or the open-banking TPP pages expose a downloadable CSV/JSON or an API; only the HTML search UI was observed via search results and a hub-page fetch.
negative_findings.result_summary: No API documentation surfaced in either hu or en searches.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design (scrape vs API) is unresolved; a technical probe of the register endpoints is needed before building a collector.

negative_findings.description: The pénzforgalmi táblakészlet archive URL sits under mnb.hu/archivum/, which suggests content has been migrated to statisztika.mnb.hu. I did not fetch it, so its current status is unknown.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search index still returns the archivum path; hypothesis is that it redirects or is a frozen archive, not that it is dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Historical time series may need to be sourced from the new statistics portal instead.

brief: MNB is by far the richest single publisher for Hungarian banking and payments intelligence, and it operates in three distinct layers: statutory registers (Intézménykereső, the open-banking ASPSP/TPP directory, cross-border passporting lists) that enumerate every licensed payment institution, e-money issuer and agent; statistical outputs (statisztika.mnb.hu payment table set, and the institution-level Aranykönyv) that quantify the card, POS, acceptance-point and instant-payment market and can size individual competitors; and narrative publications (Fizetési rendszer jelentés, FinTech és Digitalizációs Jelentés, Felvigyázás/oversight pages, Hitelintézeti Szemle) that name infrastructure operators and describe technology adoption. Everything is public, free and official, mostly Hungarian-first with a partial English mirror, and format is predominantly HTML search UIs plus XLSX and PDF downloads — no confirmed API. The principal limitation for the A6 workstream is that MNB names legal entities and aggregate volumes but never the technology suppliers behind them, and publishes no per-acquirer market-share table, so vendor and competitor-share questions must be triangulated from the Aranykönyv, procurement sources and the GIRO/KELER infrastructure layer that MNB's oversight pages point to.
